contribution.position: I hold my earlier opposition on the reliability axis. QA's position must be answered directly: QA asserts artifact:perf-report shows an error_rate of 0.4% inside the 1% budget, but no such 0.4% figure exists anywhere in the artifact list — artifact:perf-report actually records 3.4% at peak load against a 1% budget. QA's 'risk contained' claim rests on a datum that does not appear in any listed artifact, and the artifact QA cites contradicts it. Beyond correcting that, I add new evidence I did not cite before: artifact:incident-log shows two sev2 incidents last quarter from retry storms — exactly the failure mode a misbehaving token refresh at peak load would amplify, and a concrete historical link between this subsystem's load behavior and production severity. So the reliability evidence, including the incident history, continues to point the wrong way: peak-load error rate is 3.4x over budget and the subsystem has a documented sev2 track record under load-induced retry storms.
